proof_gates.B: Potential Phi=sum_k sum_{j=rank_k}^{k-1} j. Any adjacent swap at physical boundary i changes Phi by at most i: for an inverted adjacent pair a>b only rank_a changes by one in the filtered <=a order, by p<=i. Thus total cost >=Phi. Moving maxima N,N-1,... right greedily realizes exactly Phi, proving optimality.
proof_gates.D_X1: Legal balanced substrings are exactly consecutive sibling subtrees (or roots); operations preserve unordered rooted-forest shape. Adjacent sibling swaps are constructible, so all and only ordered representations of that unordered forest are reachable.
proof_gates.E: View a string as a Ferrers diagram with row lengths q_k=#ones before zero k. A move adds/removes an X-by-Y corner rectangle. Frozen signatures are row lengths mod Y and (equivalently) column heights mod X. If two Ferrers diagrams with equal residues differ, a rightmost excess Y-column strip has height difference divisible by X, yielding a removable X-by-Y corner rectangle; induction connects both to the same diagram.
